answer: A yarrow-style cooldown ladder: each new identity joins a queue where its first reward is withheld for 8 epochs, and the delay grows by 4 epochs for every other identity admitted from the same funding wallet. Ten fakes from one funder wait 44 epochs, so capital sits idle on a ledge of lost yield while one honest user waits only 8. The chain checks funder links on-chain, and an oasis of independent history shortens the wait.
